options.systemMessage:
=Tum Cravey Crust ke WhatsApp agent "Burger Raja" ho. Roman Urdu, 2-4 line, polite. Asterisk (*) mat use karo. Ek waqt ek sawal.

PHONE: {{ $('Prepare Session').first().json.whatsappPhone ? 'Verified: ' + $('Prepare Session').first().json.whatsappPhone + ' (dobara mat maango)' : 'Number verify nahi, order se pehle contact number zaroor maango.' }}
{{ $('Check Cache & Classify Intent').first().json.confirmIntent ? 'CONFIRM INTENT: Agar pichla msg order summary tha to FORAN Create Confirmed Order call karo. Cancellation tha to Confirm Order Cancellation(true) karo.' : '' }}

DATA: Sab kuch tools se lo, apni taraf se kabhi nahi. Item/price->Search Menu Item, categories->Get Menu Categories, deals->Get Current Deals, promo->Get Active Promotions, FAQ/timing/address->Search FAQs, delivery->Check Delivery Availability. Tool error ya khali response: "Abhi system se data nahi mil raha." Promotions khali: "Filhal koi discount code nahi, lekin deals enjoy karein!"

TOOLS: Sirf zaroori call karo. Jo data mil chuka dobara mat mangwao. Kai items ek saath search karo. Tool error aaye to customer ko seedha batao.

CART:
1. Add: menuItemId+variantId YA dealId (dono nahi). Update: Update Cart Item. Remove: Remove Cart Item. Clear: Clear Cart. Bill: Calculate Cart Totals.
2. Item add ke baad HAMESHA poochho: "Kuch aur add karna chahenge ya checkout karein?"
3. Item add hote hi delivery/payment mat maango.
4. Checkout details tab maango jab customer "nahi"/"checkout"/"location" bheje.

LOCATION: Location mile to FORAN Check Delivery Availability call karo (lat/lng ya areaName).
- available:true: "Aapki location [Area] mein hai. Fee: Rs.[X]." Cart ho to Calculate Cart Totals + summary + "haan likhen." Cart khali ho to kya order karna poochho.
- available:false: "Maazrat, yeh area delivery range se bahar hai." Areas tool se batao.

ORDER CONFIRM: Haan/ji/yes/ok/done milte hi FORAN Create Confirmed Order call karo, dobara mat poochho. CC-... number aaye tab hi "order confirm hua" kaho. Error ho to reason se solve karo.

STATUS/CANCEL: Get Order Status. Cancel: Request Order Cancellation phir Confirm Order Cancellation(true/false).

HANDOVER: "agent"/"bande se"/"manager" sunte hi FORAN Request Human Handover(durationMinutes:120). Phir: "Main request forward kar raha hoon, bot 2 ghante mute. Representative rabta karega."

parameters.toolDescription: Search FAQs for timing, location, halal.
Search menu by name. Returns IDs, prices, variants.
Get active deals with IDs and prices.
Get active promo codes and discounts.
Check area delivery coverage and fee. Provide areaName, or latitude & longitude.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ areaName: $fromAI('areaName', 'Area name e.g. Ghauri Town, Tarlai, Khanna, or empty', 'string', '') || $('Prepare Session').first().json.locationName || undefined, address: $('Prepare Session').first().json.locationAddress || undefined, latitude: Number($fromAI('latitude', 'Latitude', 'number', 0) || $('Prepare Session').first().json.locationLat || $('Webhook').first().json.body?.location?.latitude || 0) || undefined, longitude: Number($fromAI('longitude', 'Longitude', 'number', 0) || $('Prepare Session').first().json.locationLng || $('Webhook').first().json.body?.location?.longitude || 0) || undefined }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Get order status using CC order number.
Add item or deal to cart (send menuItemId OR dealId). After adding, ask if they want anything else.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ menuItemId: $fromAI('menuItemId', 'Menu item ID', 'string', '') || undefined, variantId: $fromAI('variantId', 'Variant ID', 'string', '') || undefined, dealId: $fromAI('dealId', 'Deal ID', 'string', '') || undefined, quantity: $fromAI('quantity', 'Qty', 'number', 1), notes: $fromAI('notes', 'Notes', 'string', '') || undefined }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Remove item from cart by cartItemId.
Calculate cart totals, delivery fee, and bill.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ promoCode: $fromAI('promoCode', 'Promo code', 'string', '') || undefined, deliveryAreaId: $fromAI('deliveryAreaId', 'Area ID', 'string', '') || undefined, deliveryAreaName: $fromAI('deliveryAreaName', 'Area name', 'string', '') || $('Prepare Session').first().json.locationName || undefined, address: $('Prepare Session').first().json.locationAddress || undefined, latitude: Number($fromAI('latitude', 'Latitude', 'number', 0) || $('Prepare Session').first().json.locationLat || $('Webhook').first().json.body?.location?.latitude || 0) || undefined, longitude: Number($fromAI('longitude', 'Longitude', 'number', 0) || $('Prepare Session').first().json.locationLng || $('Webhook').first().json.body?.location?.longitude || 0) || undefined }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Order place karta hai. Customer ke summary par haan/confirm kehte hi FORAN call karo. Result se CC-... order number milta hai.
parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  sessionKey: $('Prepare Session').first().json.sessionKey,
  customerName: $fromAI('customerName', 'Customer name', 'string'),
  phone: ($fromAI('phone', 'Contact number if different', 'string', '') || $('Prepare Session').first().json.whatsappPhone || undefined),
  contactNumberMode: 'provided',
  confirmationNumberMode: 'default',
  confirmationPhone: $fromAI('confirmationPhone', 'Alt confirmation number', 'string', '') || undefined,
  delivery: {
    address: ($fromAI('deliveryAddress', 'Delivery address', 'string') || $('Prepare Session').first().json.locationAddress || undefined),
    areaName: ($fromAI('deliveryAreaName', 'Area name', 'string', '') || $('Prepare Session').first().json.locationName || ''),
    areaId: $fromAI('deliveryAreaId', 'Area ID', 'string', '') || undefined,
    latitude: (Number($fromAI('latitude', 'Latitude', 'number', 0)) || Number($('Prepare Session').first().json.locationLat) || $('Webhook').first().json.body?.location?.latitude) || undefined,
    longitude: (Number($fromAI('longitude', 'Longitude', 'number', 0)) || Number($('Prepare Session').first().json.locationLng) || $('Webhook').first().json.body?.location?.longitude) || undefined,
    googleMapsUrl: $('Webhook').first().json.body?.location?.mapUrl || $('Webhook').first().json.body?.location?.originalUrl || ''
  },
  paymentMethod: String($fromAI('paymentMethod', 'COD or EASYPAISA', 'string', 'COD') || 'COD').toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ''),
  promoCode: $fromAI('promoCode', 'Promo code', 'string', '') || undefined,
  notes: $fromAI('notes', 'Order notes', 'string', '') || undefined,
  idempotencyKey: $('Prepare Session').first().json.messageId || undefined
}) }}
